notes: Repository face and delivery hardening: the two READMEs now tell the whole truth about the product in both languages. The stale Roadmap bullet claiming Web3 was awaiting a go order is replaced by the shipped fact - nine venues, six exchange tools, prepare -> human approval -> execute with caps that ship at zero and market orders that never auto-approve, and no withdrawal or on-chain transfer code at all. The console story is corrected from the retired five-panel layout to the real seven views, and the Verify walkthrough follows. The release badge no longer renders a red "repo not found" (shields cannot read a private repository) - it is a static version badge kept in sync by the release SOP. Highlights now name the 0.5.39/0.5.40 console surface: the activation checklist, the credential slot editor that ever only shows slot names and lengths, the restart/update/doctor buttons, the cron list with delete, the channel send test, and the hooks and schedule editors. Documentation gained a grouped one-line index of all 31 capability documents - lifting the five never-mentioned capabilities off zero - plus a performance and portability paragraph of only verifiable facts (stdlib-only core, lazily loaded voice and image dependencies, fully local loopback operation, SSE streaming), a private-clone credential note, and the 25-tool / 9-venue / 12-E2E-leg facts in the quality-gates table; the telemetry claim is scoped to the product runtime, and the Chinese edition gains a back-link and five idiom fixes. Both editions stay structurally symmetric section for section. Two delivery-audit gaps are fixed: the imagegen test legs now isolate the key slot (with the console-side env-then-slot fallback, a machine that has MODEL_API_KEY set would otherwise flip two legs - reproduced with a fake key, then verified green), and install.sh gains a genuine read-only --check with the 0/2/1 semantics, zero writes and no boot, matching its own header documentation. Gates after this car: core 1180/1180 (verified again with a fake key present), source lint 0/66, packs 536/536, publish gate READY(0), setup wizard 99/99, doctor 0F/0W.
